lineages.name: Alpha Centaurian
lineages.name_zh: 半人馬座 α 星人

scoring.response_geometry: legal-response-whitened contrasts: BIP states variance 1; BWS 3D Cov=I; CROSS 8D Cov=I
scoring.point_estimate: 0.50 nominal cosine + 0.025 each of 20 symmetric OAT convention views
scoring.centrality: fixed geometry-only additive offsets from 50/50 isotropic + uniform legal structural null

structural_t_score.formula: 50 + 10*(g-mean)/sd; UI may clamp 0..100; common transform for all 21 classes

scoring.uncertainty: 21 model-view band + 49 whole-family robust-ensemble jackknife band; bands never alter point estimate

v4_1_result_layer.classification_stability_index: 100 * min(central winner-runner structural margin percentile, weighted model-view top1 agreement, whole-family-jackknife top1 agreement). This is a weakest-link structural stability index, not a probability.
v4_1_result_layer.all_variants_flag: separate boolean: every one of 21 scoring views and every one of 49 whole-family robust-ensemble jackknives keeps the same Primary
v4_1_result_layer.pair_specific_layer: for the actual Primary vs runner-up, report model/family pair agreement, worst pair margin, plus frozen pair geometry under nominal, item dropout, whole-family dropout and all 1024 extreme corners
v4_1_result_layer.risk_policy: uncertainty never changes the 21 fit scores or Primary; it only describes robustness of the result

scoring.response_geometry: whitened legal contrasts: BIP variance-1; BWS 3D covariance I; CROSS 8D covariance I
